name: CV and Cover Letter Generator - Local (Ollama)

nodes.name: Build Prompts
nodes.notes: Prompts and profile live in the prompts/ folder (prompts.js, profile.md)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Build Prompts').item.json.resumeRequest.model, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { num_ctx: 8192, num_predict: 4096, temperature: 0.3 }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $('Build Prompts').item.json.resumeRequest.system }, ...$('Build Prompts').item.json.resumeRequest.messages] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Build Prompts').item.json.letterRequest.model, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { num_ctx: 8192, num_predict: 4096, temperature: 0.3 }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $('Build Prompts').item.json.letterRequest.system }, ...$('Build Prompts').item.json.letterRequest.messages] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, engine: 'local', resumePdf: $('Compile Resume PDF').item.json.pdf, letterPdf: $json.pdf, atsReport: $('Parse Resume JSON').item.json.ATS_REPORT, headline: $('Parse Resume JSON').item.json.HEADLINE, company: $('Parse Cover Letter JSON').item.json.COMPANY_NAME, jobTitle: $('Parse Cover Letter JSON').item.json.JOB_TITLE }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, step: $prevNode.name, error: String((typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : ($json.error?.message || $json.message)) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 500) }) }}
